source.frame_numbering: PNG 0001 is PTS 0; PTS=(PNG number-1)/60, checked with ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time

completion.uncertainty: Boundary becomes clipped by media edges, residual particles fade, and tutorial touch overlay remains; do not interpret an exact terminal frame as established

touch_indicator.warning: Large white annulus is tutorial touch visualization, not Telegram product effect; it begins before reveal and overlaps early reveal frames

direct_observations.visual_character: An expanding centre-out reveal with a very broad feather; stationary strongly blurred colored image under many small bright speckles; no product label or icon visible

fitted_geometry_not_exact_native_paramet.method: Fit a smoothstep radial alpha field against the high-pass clear photo, using Gaussian sigma 5 px highpass. Fit source frames 454–465 against frame 480. Exclude media edges and tutorial-ring radii 35–125 px around(600,398). Main trustworthy boundary fits are 456–461; early and late fits are underconstrained. This measures sharp-photo contribution, not literal renderer mask alpha.

r50_linear_fit.warning: Zero-radius intercept is extrapolation, not observed onset; only 6 boundary samples, so no exact easing identification

blurred_disk_alternative.interpretation: A Gaussian-blurred disk gives natural centre-opacity ramp at small radius; plausible reproduction model, not an identified implementation

fitted_geometry_not_exact_native_paramet.reproduction_guidance: Use near-linear spatial expansion, starting with zero revealed opacity; ramp centre opacity over roughly 30–40 ms and use a wide soft boundary. About 180 ms is a practical visible reveal duration. Keep transform stationary. Scale lengths with media width, clip to rounded media bounds. Exclude tutorial ring. Do not claim an exact native easing match.

hidden_particles.method: Luminance minus Gaussian sigma 3 px, source frame 410 (PTS 6.816667); inner ROI avoids media edges. Threshold-dependent counts are texture statistics, not exact rendered-particle counts. Adjacent-frame correlations use the same fixed ROI.
hidden_particles.interpretation: Speckles retain high temporal coherence: suitable for slowly drifting/twinkling persistent particles, not independent random noise regenerated each frame. At 0.06 luminance residual threshold the median bright component area is 4 px², equivalent circular diameter 2.26 px. Approx 2338 local bright peaks/167088 px²; extrapolated about 2700 peaks across 504×386 media. Dense tiny points, not sparse big glowing circles.

hidden_background_inferred.observation: Low-frequency field nearly stationary; RMS luminance change over 0.3 s≈0.00493 on 0–1 scale
hidden_background_inferred.approximation_test: Blurring the clear photo with Gaussian sigma≈40 source px and allowing an affine RGB transform fit the hidden low-frequency color field better than sigmas 8–96 tested; residualRGB RMS≈0.025, R²≈0.844
hidden_background_inferred.warning: Color transform/downsample/blur algorithm not identified; this is only a rough reproduction starting point, not measurement of native blurRadius

public_release_note: Historical numeric source analysis. Official media and source-containing comparison imagery are excluded from this release.
